task: Integrate v70 exact mean9 ROM into production image-filter RTL

production_change.behavior: For img_filter_kernel3x3 OP=0 and PIXEL_W=8, replace the final /9 output operation with a synchronous 4096x8 ROM. The preceding stage adds rounding bias 4, so output equals (sum_of_nine_pixels + 4) / 9. Other widths retain the original division path.
production_change.latency: Three enabled unstalled edges, II=1; CE, ready/valid, SOF/EOL, and backpressure contract preserved.
production_change.data_reset: ROM data is not reset; valid and markers are reset, and invalid output data is unspecified.

sources.change: Read-only comparison; production window RTL matches v70 candidate.

production_change.third_party_rtl: None; the mean9 table is generated from the local integer formula floor(address/9). See EXTERNAL_DESIGN_REFERENCES.md for the external snapshots used by other filter work.

validation.checks: 4096 ROM addresses in each of two modes (8192 outputs total); six arithmetic cases across W1/W8/W12, masks 1ff/013, shifts 0/2, including W1 exhaustive binary inputs and 32-window bursts.
167 independent windows; all declared output channels, CE pauses, and backpressure stability.

validation.environment: Set YOSYSHQ_ROOT to tools/oss-cad-suite/oss-cad-suite and prepend its bin, lib, and lib/ivl directories to PATH so Icarus uses the repository OSS CAD Suite rather than the incomplete Chocolatey wrapper.
validation.checks: Seven frame/window cases, 183 pixels and four windows; command-frame filters and AWB gain-solving group.

runner_repair.change: rtl_sources now excludes evidence directories as well as sim/build output directories, preventing archived pre-integration modules from being compiled alongside production RTL.
runner_repair.scope: Source discovery only; no production RTL behavior changed.

existing_v70_candidate_evidence.board: PASS; three independent SRAM loads, five GRAY8 frames, 206 pixels, 102 valid windows, eight filters; 50 MHz functional clock, CE enabled 13 of every 16 clocks; 52 UART bytes per run and digest 73D33C84.
existing_v70_candidate_evidence.pnr: Corrected-arcs routed Fmax 59.72 MHz; setup and hold checks at 50 MHz PASS.
existing_v70_candidate_evidence.resources: Full self-test top: 4469 LUT, 1678 FF, 11 BSRAM, 0 DSP; 2 more BSRAM than v69. Counts include ROM, checker, and UART; not isolated per-IP figures.
existing_v70_candidate_evidence.scope_limit: This integration reused existing v70 candidate board/synthesis evidence; no board reprogramming or synthesis was run during this production-source integration. Evidence does not claim full-frame continuous video throughput.

storage_management.cleanup: Two production-source VVP images (1517904 bytes) were removed by TemporaryDirectory; the image-core VVP (686499 bytes) was deleted immediately after the standard runner completed. No VVP files remain in the retained evidence directories.

notes: The production-source runner resolves the repository root from its evidence directory and explicitly includes img_edge_gradient3x3.v for the arithmetic bench.
The standard image-core runner now excludes archived evidence snapshots; the final PASS was produced by invoking that unmodified command with the documented OSS CAD Suite environment.
Prior production kernel source remains archived in prior_rtl/img_filter_kernel3x3.v with its pre-integration hash recorded in production_before.json.
